sections.Profile:
"Flash Gordon," a pinball machine released by Bally in February 1981, is renowned for its innovative design and challenging gameplay. It was the first split-level pinball machine from Bally, featuring a distinctive upper playfield, and it was also the first to use the "Squawk and Talk" sound board, which added voice and sound effects to enhance the gaming experience.
